---
title: Stream prices off-chain
description: Receive every signed update as it happens.
---

```ts
import { MirrorClient } from "lean-oracle-sdk/mirror";

const mirror = new MirrorClient({ urls: ["https://64-227-40-35.sslip.io"] });
const stream = mirror.stream(["Crypto.BTC/USDT", "Crypto.ETH/USDT"], (update) => {
  for (const p of update.prices) console.log(p.feedId, p.price, p.expo, update.publishTimeMs);
}, { onError: console.error });

// later
stream.close();
```

- Works in browsers and Node 20+ (pass a `WebSocket` constructor on older Node).
- Anonymous clients may hold two streams at once.
- Values are decoded from the signed blob. Pass `committees` to the `MirrorClient` to verify
  signatures too.
- For display only, polling `latest` every second or two is often simpler.
